provenance.recordType: Saved test evaluation rows across the 52-site network; absent eligible rows remain null
provenance.runtimeExecution: None: extracted existing saved results only
provenance.sourceELFQuantity: Estimated Local Flows (ELF), six-hourly CFS in source files

caveats: Recorded historical evaluation, not a new model execution or a live forecast.
All 52 ELF sites are included. The selected window has 1,233 saved paired rows across 51 sites; gaps remain null. Nickajack (ELF46) has no saved eligible test predictions in the selected model run.
Each model input uses the target week plus twelve preceding weeks; this is not a thirteen-week forecast lead.
Historical reconstruction uses target-week historical forcing. It is not an out-of-sample weather forecast.
ELF means Estimated Local Flows. Site quantities can be local, incremental, or allocated; they are not universally total upstream inflow. Do not sum across overlapping sites.
Displayed per-site metrics and volume totals cover only saved eligible pairs in this window. Missing weeks are not zero and are not included in cumulative totals.
No retraining, calibration or bias correction was performed to prepare this display.

Interactive map boundaries are USGS-derived reconstructions, and markers are forcing-region centroids, not dam/outlet positions. The supplied historical reference map and schematic include nodes 53 and 54 outside the supplied ELF01–52 file set.

steps.detail: 1,233 saved eligible pairs at 51 sites; 119 site-week gaps remain missing, including all 26 positions for Nickajack.

steps.detail: Inspect weekly ELF volumes and sample-only metrics for any site. Forecast/downscaling/economic execution is a separate live integration, not claimed by these historical results.
